_meta.model: telescope focus (D, F_tel) -> ideal collimator f_col (= F_tel x W) -> pupil of diameter W (cold stop) -> ideal camera f_cam -> detector; effective focal ratio = f_cam / W; pixel scale = 206265 x p / (D x F_tel x f_cam / f_col).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/imaging/niri/ or rawdata/imaging/hawki/, or an existing file reused by key (VLTSPE, EM1, EM2, EUT from data/imaging/reimagers.md). derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). value null / NOT FOUND marks a gap; nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_check: Every quote (and every alternative's quote) was machine-checked against the saved file: pdftotext -layout and -raw for PDFs; tag-stripped text, entity-unescaped raw source and raw source for HTML (incl. the ESO archive header pages); the .zmx as is. Normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, backticks, dashes, minus, soft hyphens, multiplication/micro/tilde/plus-minus signs mapped to ASCII; whitespace collapsed; a piece also passes with all whitespace removed or after joining hyphenated line breaks. ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces. Two ESO figures (HAWK-I_gap.gif, HAWK-I_det_def.gif) have no text layer: their values are marked as read off the figure.
